Modern Water Purification Technologies

2026 RO Technology

Purifier configurations vary by model and water source. We help you choose the right combination after checking your requirement and water quality.

💧 RO (Reverse Osmosis)

Reduces many dissolved impurities and is commonly used for higher-TDS water sources.

🔬 UV Purification

Uses ultraviolet light as a disinfection stage in suitable purifier designs.

🧪 UF / MF Filtration

Membrane filtration options used in multi-stage purification systems.

⚖️ TDS Control

Helps manage the final water profile in compatible RO systems.

🌿 Mineral / Remineralization

Designed to add or retain selected minerals after purification, depending on the system.

✨ Alkaline Water

Some purifiers include an alkaline stage designed to raise the pH of treated water.

🟠 Copper Enrichment

Some models use copper-based technology to add copper to purified water.

💡 UV in Tank

Selected models use UV/UV-LED in the storage tank for additional treatment of stored water.

🏠 Under-Counter RO

Space-saving purifier layouts designed for modular kitchens and hidden installation.

Trusted Local RO & RO Service

About Sunil RO Expert • Shalimar Garden, Ghaziabad

About Sunil RO Expert Sunil RO Expert is your trusted local specialist for comprehensive RO sales, installation, repair, and routine maintenance, designed to provide safe, clean drinking water without hidden costs or technical jargon. We provide fast, accurate troubleshooting for all major brands—resolving low water flow, unusual noises, power failures, foul taste, and persistent leaks. Our technicians handle everything from high-quality RO membrane, sediment, and activated carbon filter replacements to complete sanitization tune-ups, safe new unit installations, and hassle-free system relocations. Backed by a deep understanding of local groundwater and municipal supply conditions, we conduct precise on-site TDS and water quality testing to address hard water issues and recommend only the exact filtration your setup requires. Serving homes, offices, and small businesses across the local area, we guarantee upfront, transparent pricing, genuine durable spare parts, and prompt doorstep service focused entirely on practical fixes rather than upselling unnecessary parts. To schedule a visit, contact Sunil RO Expert by phone or WhatsApp at +91 9818876665 or via email at suniltaneja1976@gmail.com.
